title: Voice
description: Text to speech for the narration. A profile file lists only what it changes: every field is optional and falls back to profiles/default (voice.json for Thai; with language en, voice.en.json). The defaults below are Thai's.

engine.description: TTS engine. makham speaks Thai, kokoro speaks English. Follows language when left out.

language.description: Language of the narration: th (Thai) or en (US English). Setting en starts from profiles/default/voice.en.json.

model.description: Thai: makham_female sounds natural; paradee is faster with a metallic buzz, for drafts. English: kokoro (int8, 92 MB) or kokoro_fp32 (326 MB).

speaker.description: English only: the Kokoro speaker (af_ female, am_ male). Default af_heart.

phrase_gap.description: Thai: pause at each space in the narration. English: pause between the parts of a line too long for one go.

max_rate.description: Syllables per second above which a line gets the FAST flag (English default 5.5).

eq.description: ffmpeg audio filter applied to every clip. Empty for none (the English default).

breath.description: The inhale the model starts each phrase with (English default keep).

lexicon.description: Word -> phonemes, for words the G2P cannot reach. Thai: สปาร์ก -> sa↓.paːk↑. English (misaki's US set): Eventpop -> ˈɛvəntpˌɑp.
